edits.why: line 17 is a bold centred colophon (Записано отъ чукчи Ајнанвата лѣтомъ 1897 года…), inset about equally on both sides (left ~70 px, right ~20 px displayed) and set in heavier type: a centred short line, not a paragraph start; MainZone-Other covers headings and such lines.

notes.text: Colophon naming informant and date; relabelled Other as centred bold. If the editor reads the left inset as a paragraph indent, MainZone-P stands.
